senses.gloss: kliśyati, also kili˚ (= Pali kilissati, ppp. kiliṭṭha, neg. a-ki˚; Skt. not in this mg.), becomes soiled (see also saṃkliśyati): Divy 〔193.20〕 akliṣṭāni (em., confirmed by the foll.) vāsāṃsi kliśyanti (mss. kliṣ˚); 〔57.19〕 akliṣṭāni vāsāṃsi; cf. Pali akiliṭṭha-vasana; ppp. kiliṣṭa, afflicted, LV 〔131.17〕; Mv 〔iii.446.1〕.
